cases.description: Every field; two assets, two count limits.
m_full version 2 with a lower per-action max: same mandate_id, same counter key.
Required fields only; mandate_id all zero; recipients any, kinds any, defaults.

reject.description: Signed over the mandate hash under the verdict signature tag.
An asset rule with neither per_action_max nor periods.
A kind with an upper-case letter.
Mandate key 14 = 1. Before draft.5 the key was unknown; since draft.5 it is sig_type and the value 1 is refused (bytes unchanged, same error).
A zero byte after the signed mandate.
sig_type 1: Ed25519 has one encoding, the absent key.
principal_hrp with an upper-case letter (decoding charset).
sig_type 2 with a compressed key whose x has no point on secp256k1.
fast_mode_max_delay 0: off has one encoding, the absent key.
An auditor key that is a low-order X25519 point (all zero).
An auditor whose kid is not SHA-256(tag(edicta/v1/auditor-kid) || pubkey)[0..16].
A label with a double quote.
A label with a leading space.
A label with a trailing space.
A label with a non-ASCII character (U+00E9).
Two auditors with the same label.
sig_type 3, last byte of s flipped.
sig_type 3 with s replaced by n - s and v flipped (the same point, high s).
sig_type 3 with v = 0 (recovery id without the 27 offset).
sig_type 3 signed by secp256k1 p2, names the address of p1.

adoption.description: Version 2 changes the scale of test:eth, which no allow ever used: refused, the cell keeps version 1.
Version 2 drops test:eth, version 3 lists it again at another scale: refused, the cell still knows test:eth.
Version 2 keeps every scale and adds test:btc; a restart with version 2 uses the cell.
The cell holds version 2; version 1 is refused.
Version 1 again with another per-action max: refused.

The cell holds 1012 assets. Version 64 adds 12 new ones and reaches the bound of 1024: switched. Version 65 adds one more: refused, the cell keeps version 64. Another version 65 that lists only known assets: switched.
A private mandate (auditors, state_salt) and its version 2 with another state_salt: refused, since the public chain links of one counter cross versions and both sides must blind with one salt.
